errors.text: The proposed Mg-Zr-Ti transient-liquid-phase route replaces the target ball-milled MgAlTiVFeCo BCC powder and SPS intervention, so it does not reconstruct the material or processing strategy.
The hypothesis places the optimum at 900-950 °C rather than testing the target optimum of 1000 °C.

No specific, evidence-supported liquid-forming additive or phase diagram is provided; the suggestion that a transition-metal hydride would decompose to form a liquid near 850 °C is not established by the cited evidence.
The proposed homogeneous metastable solid solution omits the target oxide barrier phases AlV2O4, FeAl2O4, and FeTiO3 and therefore invokes a fundamentally different oxidation/corrosion mechanism.
The falsification experiment omits oxidation testing at 900 °C, parabolic oxidation-rate constants, and a 1000 °C comparison arm.
